title: Package the principles, workflow, agents and hooks as a Claude Code plugin
note: Replaces the local copy in ~/.claude. See D-001, D-002.

title: Dev-log kit: Markdown entries built into one styled page
note: Taken from the Total War Chess dev-log and de-branded. See D-004.

title: Workflow uses i-have-adhd, ponytail, mempalace and ECC
Record as JSON for agents, notebook pages for the human
Roadmap as a board the owner can move cards on
Research before major decisions, with an HTML report
First real run: set up the record and notebook in an existing project
note: Verified so far on a demo project only. Watch the set-up steps in NOTEBOOK.md run end to end, including the move from the old Markdown record.

title: This repo's own notebook and dev-log
note: Notebook pages and dev-log entry 001 built. See D-013.

title: Hook commands call `python`, which is `python3` on most Linux and macOS machines
note: Hooks now run under bash and pick python3 or python once. See D-018. Untested on a real Mac: R-014.

title: `build_dev_log.py` is 323 lines with a long main()
note: One cohesive, working builder copied unchanged from Total War Chess; left as it is.

title: Board cards cannot be dragged on a touch screen
note: Edit, then Column, moves a card without dragging.

title: Board cards: links and files that open, categories with colours, flags
note: Built, independently tested, reviewed and security-reviewed. See D-015 to D-019.

title: Test on macOS and Linux: launchers, hooks, opening and revealing files
note: Nothing has run there yet. On the Mac: pull, double-click tools/open-roadmap.command, drag a card, click an image link and a folder link; then tools/rebuild-dev-log.command; then install the plugin and start a session to see the hooks load.

title: A second board change made while a save is still in flight is refused
note: The board shows 'Not saved: changed on disk' and reloads; the change has to be made again. A person is rarely that fast.

title: A record file broken by hand while the board is open blanks the board
note: The helper serves roadmap.json and board.json without validating them on read.

title: Links on a mapped network drive are opened like local files
note: Only paths that start with two slashes and symbolic links are refused. See D-016.

title: `roadmap-board.js` and the test file are over the 300-line smoke alarm
note: Each does one job. The board script's only seam is the Categories and flags dialog, which shares its state with the rest; splitting it now would only pass state back and forth.
